claim: Port 0x303B selects both sprite and pattern-upload index, so an ISR moving sprites garbles pattern uploads in progress; stay off it during uploads, count skipped steps and make them up with even update lengths.

evidence.text: An ISR moving sprites garbled uploads; count skipped steps and make them up; even update lengths are needed.
KS1 Issue 2, core 3.03.00 (nxsuite SP02): one port $303B write set both the pattern-upload slot ($5B) and the attribute index ($57).
